name: Office of Learning Operations
note: A fictional department. No real people, departments, or system screens. The payroll calendar dates come from the published 2026 payroll calendar; dates marked [SME] still need confirming.

calendars.label: Monthly
calendars.note: October's cutoff has passed when the week starts. Exempt changes approved this week pay in November, with retro for October where the element supports it. Next cutoff: Wed Nov 18. Exempt time off is entered in Oracle absences, not on time cards.
calendars.source: 2026 Payroll Calendar, monthly payroll (the published rows put each monthly cutoff on the 18th)

calendars.label: Biweekly
calendars.who: Non-exempt (hourly) staff, paid from approved time cards
calendars.note: Time cards are due Monday at noon; then payroll signs off. The Retro Change Cutoff (for changes dated in past periods) is usually two business days before the HCM transaction cutoff.

calendars.label: Weekly
calendars.note: Weekly time cards close every week. Check them weekly, like biweekly ones.
